Players Committee card image of [[Luke Skywalker, Rebel Scout (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. If drawn for destiny, may take into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. Power +1 for each Dark Jedi here. Luke's weapon destiny draws are +1. At same site, opponent must first use 1 Force to fire a weapon. Immune to attrition < 6.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/lukeskywalkerrebelscout.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4 a5142dd] (12 May 2020). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
